[Note: Late-stage content leans toward Chaos/Khornate themes and may be disturbing!] 
Shen Yu wakes up to find himself about to enter the battleground of the Multiracial Lords’ War.
Panicked, he discovers his Lord Talent is:
[War Enthusiasm] [SS] 
[Your citizens are fanatically passionate about war.] 
System Review: The people have gone mad. Many are willing to die horribly in your name.
So now he’s basically being forced to become an otherworldly warmonger hairdresser?!
Faced with the system’s three randomly assigned cultural options, Shen Yu decisively chooses the most combat-oriented one:
[Winter Empire] 
Increased recruitment cap for starting units
Extra rewards for winning wars
Higher citizen desire for war
Reduced income from economic buildings
System Review: Why would your land grow my wheat?
Years later, as other lords form raid teams to farm his war-torn territory, Shen Yu sneers:
“I’m poor? Try saying that to my army.”
And in the stunned gaze of all the surrounding lords, from that simple, shabby wooden barracks behind him,
countless dragon riders suddenly burst into the sky.

143309.synopsis:
Inspired by “The Tinder Box” by Hans Christian Andersen.
Isaac, a half-witch born from a witch and a human. Because he is not a pureblood witch, he cannot go to the Land of the Dark Moon, where witches fled from human oppression, and he lives modestly in the human world, hiding that he is a witch.
And in the royal palace where Isaac works as a guard, there is Prince Kaian, who is outstanding in appearance and ability but has a very nasty temper. He is one of the royals of this country who suffers terrible pain on the new moon due to a witch’s curse, but unlike other royals, he does not seek the help of a wizard to alleviate the pain, enduring hellish pain every month and hating witches to the bone.
Isaac, who is living a relatively peaceful life while guarding the prince’s palace, where he is eager to catch witches, is one day visited by three brazen cats who steal his precious food and hand him a flint as a reward. And what appeared before Isaac, who struck the flint, were three large tigers. They demand that Isaac bring them the flint box in the king’s treasury, and in return, they offer to grant him three wishes every new moon night, when the witch’s power is strongest.
Thinking it was a dream, Isaac said, ‘A night with the greatest beauty in this country,’ and the tiger brought him Prince Kaian, who was suffering from extreme pain because it was the dark moon…

169677.synopsis:
Cheon Si-hyun, a 4th-year resident at Sama University Hospital.
While treating a patient suffering from severe delusions, he is involved in a mysterious accident just one day before his board exam.
The joy of regaining consciousness and surviving was short-lived.
What awaited him was the first day of his 1st year of residency, a time he never wanted to return to.
If you returned to your first year, how would you want to live?
The 「All Charts in the World」 System and a top-class secretary will assist you with your training.
A medical suspense fantasy regression story just for you.
It begins now.
